messages:
Jordan K.: Heads up — Atlas just flagged the H100 tranche for eu-west slipping to 2026-04-18. They can do a partial ship (20/60) earlier if we sign an amended PO. Any appetite for a price credit on the delay? Also need to confirm RMA flow if we see DOA — vendor proposing a 'conditional repair' pathway instead of immediate replacement. @Carter (ops) @Maya R. any operational constraints?

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Hi Jordan — confirmed ETA 2026-04-18 for full tranche. We can split: ship 20 units next week (AMS staging), remaining 40 in the follow-on shipment. Two remediation options for DOA: immediate replacement air-expedite (higher cost) or conditional repair at our depot with replacement only if repair fails. Commercials: 3% credit on the delayed tranche OR 1.5% per-unit rebate if you accept conditional repair SLA. Customs note: some EU nodes may add 48–72h clearance. AWB will be provided before ship.

Carter (ops): 20 units would unblock aeu-canary. Prefer AMS staging (closer to eu-west infra). Important: units must arrive pre-flashed with our fleet provisioning image and firmware 1.3.2 (we run custom hypervisor). If Atlas cannot flash, we need a mandatory reflash + smoke-test step before we accept into pool. Where would the depot repair happen (country)?

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Depot in FRA or NL depending on carrier manifest; we can lock to AMS depot for this contract. We can add a mandatory 'reflash + smoke test' step to the SLA and attach photo/log evidence. Conditional repair definition: attempt repair within 10 business days; if successful, reflash to stock FW and run smoke; if unrepairable, fallback to air-expedite replacement within 48h. We will provide CSV manifest with serials and firmware state 24h prior to ship. Sample PO snippet for the amendment: 

```
PO: RW-2026-1387
Line: H100-80GB x60
Amend: Ship 20 now (invoice for 20), balance 40 on invoice hold pending full delivery
AWB (sample): ATLAS/123-ATLAS-987
```

Maya R.: Conditional repair is ok only if we get the reflash + smoke step and explicit rollback guarantee. Last time repaired units returned with wrong firmware and subtle perf degradation; we lost time triaging in-prod. Need unit-level acceptance: reflash, run our 6 smoke tests, and a perf spot-check before marking as deployable. Also insist on serial-level photos and md5 of flashed image.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Agreed — we will include reflash + smoke test and attach logs (timestamped). We can capture image md5 and a 3-photo manifest per unit. Fallback air-expedite cost if repair fails is capped at $1,800/unit for next-day. Depot repair labor is borne by Atlas under the conditional repair SLA. For customs delays >72h we will process expedited re-export at vendor cost.

Jordan K.: Sounds good. @RMA-bot can you create a playbook flagged conditional-repair=true and link to procurement amendment? Also add clause: unit-level acceptance testing window 2hrs/unit, failure threshold 2% — above that we trigger replacement + credit.

RMA-bot: Created ticket #RMA-8421 and attached provisional playbook: conditional-repair=true; acceptance_test_hours=2; fail_threshold_pct=2; notify=customs-team,ops-deck,procurement. (reacts :white_check_mark:)

Carter (ops): I'll prep AMS staging and the flash pipeline. Reminder: we need manifest columns: unit_serial, pre_ship_fw, post_repair_fw, depot_id, repair_notes. Also provide preferred inbound time window so we can reserve dock slots. Any extra freight for the air-expedite fallback?

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Fallback air-expedite capped at $1,800/unit; we will absorb depot repair labor costs. We will send the CSV manifest 24h before ship and a separate customs packet for AMS clearance. ETA for first 20 (if amended PO signed today): ship 2026-04-02, arrival AMS 2026-04-03. Full tranche ETA remains 2026-04-18.

Maya R.: Please ensure the SLA includes an explicit firmware reflash checklist and md5 capture, plus a clause that units failing our post-reflash smoke can be returned to vendor for full credit or immediate replacement.

Jordan K.: I'll update the PO amendment with the reflash + smoke clause, fail threshold, and the commercial rebate option (we'll take the 1.5% unit rebate if conditional repair is used). Signing this afternoon. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Carter (ops): Noted — prepping AMS dock reservation and the reflash image. Will coordinate with security on serial ingestion.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Updated amendment will land in your inbox tonight; manifest to follow 24h prior to ship. Closing loop on our side.
